text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 4 पर दो कौवों की कहानी पढ़ो। एक ने थैले में रुई भरी, दूसरे ने नमक। फिर बारिश आई...
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 4 par do kauvon ki kahani padho. Ek ne thaile mein rui bhari, doosre ne namak. Phir baarish aayi...
text.en: Read the story of two crows on page 4. One filled his sack with cotton, the other with salt. Then it rained...

steps.question: What was the challenge?
options: Which crow could fly higher carrying a sack.
steps.answer: Which crow could fly higher carrying a sack.
steps.modelAnswer: The challenge was to see which crow could fly higher while carrying sacks of the same size.

modelMeaning.hi: चुनौती थी कि एक जैसे थैले उठाकर कौन सा कौवा ज़्यादा ऊँचा उड़ सकता है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Chunauti thi ki ek jaise thaile uthaakar kaun sa kauva zyaada ooncha ud sakta hai.

steps.question: What was there in the first crow's sack?

questionMeaning.hi: पहले कौवे के थैले में क्या था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Pehle kauve ke thaile mein kya tha?

steps.modelAnswer: There was cotton in the first crow's sack.

modelMeaning.hi: पहले कौवे के थैले में रुई थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pehle kauve ke thaile mein rui thi.

steps.question: What was there in the second crow's sack?

questionMeaning.hi: दूसरे कौवे के थैले में क्या था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Doosre kauve ke thaile mein kya tha?

steps.modelAnswer: There was salt in the second crow's sack.

modelMeaning.hi: दूसरे कौवे के थैले में नमक था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Doosre kauve ke thaile mein namak tha.

steps.question: Who was expecting rain?
steps.modelAnswer: The second crow was expecting rain.

modelMeaning.hi: दूसरे कौवे को बारिश की उम्मीद थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Doosre kauve ko baarish ki ummeed thi.

steps.question: Who was defeated?
steps.modelAnswer: The first crow was defeated because his cotton soaked up the rain and became very heavy.

modelMeaning.hi: पहला कौवा हारा क्योंकि उसकी रुई ने बारिश का पानी सोख लिया और बहुत भारी हो गई।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Pehla kauva haara kyonki uski rui ne baarish ka paani sokh liya aur bahut bhaari ho gayi.

steps.question: Why did the salt sack become light?

questionMeaning.hi: नमक का थैला हल्का क्यों हुआ?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Namak ka thaila halka kyon hua?

options: The salt dissolved in the rain.
steps.answer: The salt dissolved in the rain.

exampleMeaning.hi: चीनी चाय में घुल जाती है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Cheeni chaay mein ghul jaati hai.
